memory/index.text: Durable harness memory is stored as structured Markdown in memory/*.md, while memory/index/*.json files are generated derived indexes rather than hand-written authority.

skills/e2e-dev-harness.text: This repository contains the e2e-dev-harness skill under skills/e2e-dev-harness, with Python workflow scripts under skills/e2e-dev-harness/scripts and unittest coverage under tests.

skills/e2e-dev-harness/references/memory.text: Harness memory is optional context, not authority; current code and tests, then fresh GitNexus or Graphify evidence, take precedence over durable memory.
